statement: If a word is at its FIRST occurrence in treebank-register text of one of ~21 languages, then the frequency-rank bins of its two LEFT neighbours (prefix only, causal) rank proper nouns above position-, character-length-, form-frequency- and sentence-length-matched ordinary open-class words (expected AUC about 0.62, language range 0.51-0.72).
scope: UD DEV text of 23 languages with enough matched pairs at FIRST (eng spa cmn cmn-hans heb fas jpn fra deu ita por nld pol ukr hin vie ind urd tur ell fin plus rus and kor which fail); stratum FIRST = first occurrence of the form in the document (single mention); case-stripped; one ridge-logistic PROBE per language, leave-pair-block-out. Strongest: spa .721, heb .705, hin .704, fra .681, deu .677, nld .669, urd .666, ita .661, por .653.
outOfScope: rus 0.507 (600 pairs, below its own permutation q95 0.544); kor 0.580 (67 pairs, q95 0.638); weak: pol .570, tur .575, ukr .588, fin .593, cmn .567; arb and swe too thin (13-20 pairs). Chat: UD pooled to IRC 0.515, IRC-within-register 0.526 (near chance). NOT word-order-family-specific (same minus other family -0.0001, same>other in 14/23, sign p 0.20). A fitted probe, not a zero-shot score; no UD test.conllu read.
observables: For one token occurrence: the frequency-rank bin (12 log2 bins plus edge marker) of each of its two left neighbours, taken from the stream's own counts. No neighbour string, no capital, no POS prior, no word list. Gold UD PROPN is used only to label the probe's training pairs and to evaluate.
discovery: name-company.mjs amended run (NAME_COMPANY_PAIRBLOCK=1; header sha256 c3234d9b030573ca82c85049929c35cb65d1eafd4c16dd4344de018cb03652e1), results/name-company-pairblocks/report.json, recomputed by verify-signals.json (37/37 checks reproduce). LEFT at FIRST: mean AUC 0.6236 over 23 languages; 21 of 23 above their OWN permutation q95 (mean q95 0.5425); 14 languages >= 0.60, 9 >= 0.65; matched controls POSITION 0.505 / CHARLEN 0.500 / FREQ 0.499 / RIVALS 0.505 (all inside [0.45, 0.55]); beyond the matched rivals (LEFT+RIVALS minus RIVALS) +0.118 [0.094, 0.141], >= +0.03 in 22 of 23. With right-side lookahead (BOTH, non-causal): 0.6553, 19 >= 0.60, 12 >= 0.65, 22 of 23 above q95. Word-order shuffle was run on LATER only (0.612 -> 0.516), not on FIRST. effect = mean AUC. Discovery data = UD DEV only (all discovery used dev; test untouched).
passIf: On the untouched UD test.conllu of the same stems, with the same matching and NAME_COMPANY_PAIRBLOCK=1: mean LEFT-at-FIRST AUC >= 0.58 over the non-thin languages, >= 16 languages above their own permutation q95, >= 8 languages >= 0.62, POSITION control inside [0.45, 0.55].
failIf: Mean AUC < 0.55, or fewer than 12 languages above their own q95, or the POSITION control outside [0.45, 0.55] (the comparison is then void, not a pass).

statement: If a word is a repeated (not first) occurrence in treebank-register text, then the frequency-rank bins of its two left and two right neighbours rank proper nouns above matched ordinary words (expected AUC about 0.615, range 0.48-0.73); the shape is language-general but modest and vanishes when word order is shuffled.
scope: UD DEV text, 22 non-thin languages, stratum LATER (form seen before); probe trained and tested inside one language. Strongest: fra .726, spa .693, fas .688, urd .688, heb .685, hin .657, por .655 (three of them SOV-like), then nld .644, eng .633, cmn-hans .630, jpn .617, ind .614, cmn .614, ell .602.
outOfScope: Fails its own permutation q95 in deu (.552 vs .583), pol (.550 vs .559), ukr (.526 vs .625), tur (.481 vs .568); LEFT-only fails in jpn, deu, pol, ukr, tur, fin; arb, kor, swe thin. Not family-specific: same-family minus other-family +0.0327 [0.006, 0.059] but same>other in only 12 of 22 (sign p 0.33), 3-cluster +0.006; post-hoc the gain sits in Romance plus rus and ell (relatedness, not word order). UD pooled to IRC 0.457 (register-bound). Japanese does not collapse under shuffling (0.617 -> 0.662, 88 pairs), unexplained.
observables: Frequency-rank bins (12 log2 bins plus edge) of two left and two right neighbours, from the stream's own counts; no strings, capitals, POS prior or lists.
discovery: Same run and file as COMPANY-FIRST-LEFT (name-company-pairblocks/report.json; verify-signals.json). BOTH at LATER: mean AUC 0.6154 over 22 languages, 18 of 22 above own permutation q95 (mean q95 0.552), 14 >= 0.60, 7 >= 0.65; controls POSITION 0.500 / CHARLEN 0.500 / FREQ 0.501 / RIVALS 0.501; beyond rivals (BOTH+RIVALS minus RIVALS) +0.1154 [0.0908, 0.1388], >= +0.03 in 20 of 22; word-order shuffle over 8 languages 0.6122 -> 0.5161 (eng .633->.548, spa .693->.430, fas .688->.559, hin .657->.516). The first (invalid) run had POSITION at 0.38 because pair members fell in different blocks; the amended pair-block run is the valid one. effect = mean AUC. UD DEV only; not confirmed on a fresh fold.
passIf: On untouched UD test.conllu: mean BOTH-LATER AUC >= 0.58, >= 14 non-thin languages above their own q95, shuffled-word-order arm within 0.03 of chance, POSITION control inside [0.45, 0.55].
failIf: Mean AUC < 0.55, or word-order shuffle leaves the mean above 0.57 (then it is counts, not company), or POSITION control outside [0.45, 0.55] (void).

statement: If the text is multi-party chat (Ubuntu IRC) and the probe is trained on other days of the SAME register, then the rank-bin company of a repeated word ranks nickname occurrences above position-, length- and frequency-matched words (expected AUC about 0.61); it does not transfer from treebank text and is near chance at first mention.
scope: 8 IRC channel-days (kubuntu/ubuntu 2004-2015), 1200 LATER pairs and 726 FIRST pairs, gold = word equals a nickname that spoke that day (speaker field used only as gold); BOTH arm at LATER, leave-one-day-out.
outOfScope: Treebank to chat: UD pooled 0.457 (UD-English 0.467, SOV-like 0.529); chat to UD-English 0.505. First mention in chat: 0.526 (position arm 0.546, at the edge of the band). Pairs were NOT matched on local window mention count or recency, which the adversary found still carries 0.60-0.62 AUC in chat, so a local-count residual is not excluded. SMS, Singlish, Enron: no gold, untested.
observables: Same rank-bin company profile (two left, two right neighbours); trained on seven days, tested on the eighth. Gold nickname set only labels pairs.
discovery: report.json section C3: IRC leave-one-day-out BOTH LATER 0.6067 (1200 pairs, 8 days), IRC position arm 0.5279 (in [0.45, 0.55], so the number is controlled); FIRST LEFT 0.5259 (position arm 0.5455); UD pooled -> IRC 0.4573 (position arm 0.4739). verify-signals.json reproduces all. effect = leave-one-day-out AUC. The leave-one-day-out CV is inside the same 8 days (no fresh days yet). Matched on within-message position, form frequency, character length and message length.
passIf: On >= 8 never-used IRC channel-days with the same matching, leave-one-day-out BOTH-LATER AUC >= 0.58 with the position arm in [0.45, 0.55]; and adding window-mention-count and recency matching leaves it >= 0.56.
failIf: AUC < 0.54, or it disappears once local count and recency are matched, or the position arm leaves [0.45, 0.55] (void).

statement: If the register puts names at the head of a sentence or message (chat addressee vocatives, novels with sentence-initial subjects), then being message/sentence-initial, or the share of a form's occurrences that sit directly after the edge, identifies names: IRC chat 0.92 for the bare message-initial indicator, novels 0.66-0.85, but only about 0.53 in treebank text.
scope: Ubuntu IRC (6 + 14 + 17 channel-days used across the swarm): nicknames, first names, bots and other addressees; War and Peace and Pride and Prejudice cast forms (exploratory); UD (very weak). The observable is position/company only (no casing).
outOfScope: It marks the vocative SLOT, not names: the induced IRC kinds 9 and 6 also hold real first names, bots, mr, doc, god and non-names such as nobody, somebody, damn, err, ive, theres; software names (kind 19) and common nouns are NOT in them. UD: message-initial indicator AUC only 0.531 mean (19 of 22 languages above 0.5). Absent where names occur mid-sentence only. SMS, cosem and Enron have no gold: whether an addressee kind forms there is untested. The novel numbers (0.66, 0.85) are exploratory, post-hoc and stated in REPORT.md only (not recomputed here).
observables: (a) is the token the first word of its message/sentence (position after the stream edge); (b) share of a form's occurrences whose left neighbour is the edge; (c) company-induced kind membership with a before=edge signature (spherical k-means on neighbour-count vectors, no tags). No capitals, no priors, no lists.
discovery: IRC: 92.1% of 20,105 gold nickname occurrences (18,524) are message-initial vs 9.3% of all tokens (NAME-RULE-RESULTS.md CORRECTION); on ant-shape's 600 sampled rows 94.66% of 281 initial tokens are nickname positives vs 10.66% of 319 non-initial, and the bare message-initial indicator alone scores AUC 0.9183 (results/extras.json X2/X3; recomputed). Induced kinds (ant-kinds-chat, 14 DEV days): kind 9 = 248 forms of which 190 are nick types, purity 0.766, enrichment 16.2; kinds 9+6 hold 226 of 227 nick types; a frequency-matched non-nick type lands in kind 9 with probability 0.022 (nick types 0.837); on 17 held-out channel-days with frozen DEV centroids 290 of 379 nick types land in kind 9 (matched non-nick 0.042 vs 0.765); message-initial share kind 9 0.759, kind 6 0.698, every other kind <= 0.109, overall 0.095 (kind_position.rerun.out reproduces this). UD: sentInitial AUC mean 0.531, 19/22 languages above 0.5 (ant-shape A7_rivals). Novels (exploratory): before-edge share alone 0.66 (W&P) and 0.85 (P&P); reader's edge-based being rule hears 29% of P&P cast tokens vs 7% of controls (W&P 1.3% vs 2.5%). effect = message-initial AUC on IRC. Fresh-fold status: the kind landing replicated on 17 held-out channel-days with frozen centroids; the message-initial shares were measured on the 6 name-rule days and the 14 DEV days (ant-shape's 600 rows come from the 6 days); the novel numbers are unconfirmed and exploratory.
passIf: On >= 8 IRC channel-days never read by the swarm: message-initial share of nickname tokens >= 0.85 vs <= 0.15 for matched tokens, and a re-induced kind with before=edge signature holds >= 60% of nick types with frequency-matched non-nick landing <= 0.06; for a novel: edge-share AUC >= 0.60 on a third book with the cast fixed before the run.
failIf: Initial share of nickname tokens < 0.70 on fresh chat days, or a kind induced with the edge feature REMOVED still shows >= 60% nick purity (then it is not position), or novel edge-share AUC < 0.55 on a third book.

statement: If a recurring token in IRC-style chat is deleted and the causal window re-read by the three prior-free readers, then the number of referent-entry slots that change (S_ENTRY, higher = more name-like, direction fixed in advance) ranks nickname occurrences above position-, frequency-, message-length- and character-length-matched ordinary words at about 0.65-0.72, above a residual local mention count (0.60-0.62); the full 104-d record (a probe) reaches 0.72-0.79 and collapses when the words are shuffled inside messages.
scope: Ubuntu IRC, tokens of >= 3 characters that recur >= 2 times in their 256-message causal window; ablation-derived slot deltas of impact.mjs's three prior-free readers; strata message-initial (INIT) and non-initial (NONINIT) reported separately.
outOfScope: The pre-registered licence C7 FAILED (R_LOCAL 0.596 INIT / 0.618 NONINIT outside [0.45, 0.55]), so the strict verdict is UNDERPOWERED(matching): a local-count residual is not excluded (strict subsets: R_LOCAL 0.567 / 0.600, S_ENTRY 0.634 / 0.714). Matched negatives were ordinary words, not other rare strings, so 'a username string' is not excluded. S_SPAN is nearly as good as S_ENTRY once matched (INIT 0.644 vs 0.653), so 'slot beats span' holds only in NONINIT (0.717 vs 0.606). Earlier unmatched numbers (S_ENTRY 0.843, R_FREQ 0.853, physics within-count 0.81) are upper bounds contaminated by position and the 3-character figure floor. War and Peace 0.513, UD PROPN at chance after position matching (0.454). A causal first mention is invisible (0.500).
observables: Ablate the token, re-read the prefix window, count changed referent-entry slots (S_ENTRY); rivals R_LOCAL, R_BURST, R_RECENCY computed from the same stream. No capital, prior or list; gold nickname set only evaluates. The 104-d record variant is a fitted ridge-logistic PROBE (existence test), labelled as such.
discovery: ant-adversary round C (8 channel-days never read by the adversary; PREREG_IRC_A2.md sha256 1289e1a2ae6b38fe...), results/irc_analysis_C.json, recomputed in verify-signals.json. S_ENTRY: INIT 0.6531 [0.629, 0.679] (480 pairs), NONINIT 0.7166 (457 pairs), POOL 0.6841 (937 pairs); R_LOCAL 0.5962 / 0.6184 / 0.6071; R_BURST 0.585 / 0.578 / 0.582; position control 0.5075 / 0.4943 / 0.5056. Record IMP (probe): 0.7179 [0.692, 0.748] / 0.7905 [0.749, 0.821] / 0.7407, increment over fitted rivals +0.0707 [0.031, 0.110] / +0.1495 [0.121, 0.172] / +0.1048 (fit-level null q95 0.044 / 0.041 / 0.035); company-shuffled record 0.574 / 0.542 / 0.566. Kind-mate negatives (ant-kinds-chat K arm): record 0.81 / 0.83 vs count 0.63 / 0.73, but 25% of those negatives were < 3 characters; with >= 3 characters and message-initial matched on the same rows, record 0.835 vs local model 0.637. effect = pooled S_ENTRY AUC. Rounds A and A2 were used to design the matching; round C is the fresh fold for that design.
passIf: On >= 8 more never-read IRC days with count-exact and recency-exact matching plus rare-string negatives (package/software names): S_ENTRY AUC >= 0.62 pooled, R_LOCAL inside [0.45, 0.55], S_ENTRY minus R_LOCAL >= +0.04 with a day-bootstrap lower bound > 0.
failIf: S_ENTRY AUC < 0.57 once local count and recency are matched exactly, or S_ENTRY <= R_LOCAL, or the company-shuffled record stays above 0.60 (then it is counts).
